schema_notes.ingredients_parsed: Array of {name, component}. component is null for single-component products; a named string (e.g. 'noodles', 'masala_tastemaker', 'choco_creme', 'cookie_shell', 'dark_chocolate_paste') for multi-part products.
schema_notes.nutrition.basis: One of 'per_100g', 'per_100ml', 'per_serving_only' (product has no meaningful per-100 basis, e.g. single-serve items or per-bottle-only labels). All nutrient values live under nutrition.values regardless of basis, using this basis as the reference amount.
schema_notes.pack_size: {value, unit} where unit is 'g' or 'ml'. Never inferred — matches what the label/pack actually states.
schema_notes.allergen_declaration_present: True if the label carries any allergen section at all (even if empty/none declared). False if no allergen section was printed on the label.
schema_notes.data_note: Present only where a real discrepancy, ambiguity, or provenance issue was found and could not be fully resolved. Absence of this field does not guarantee zero ambiguity, only that none was flagged.
schema_notes.canonical_scope: 23 products below (ids 1-23) are the project's canonical set. Diet Coke was collected as the canonical diet/zero-sugar product; Coca-Cola Zero Sugar was evaluated during Phase 1 but permanently removed from this dataset due to a confirmed platform-side data error (its Instamart listing showed regular Coca-Cola's ingredients panel across three independent images, contradicting its own 0g-sugar nutrition table) and is not retained anywhere in this file.
